services.desc: This comfortable 4 Bedroom waterfront house is the perfect home away from home for the whole family. Located in Otter Creek (just a few minute boat ride to the main channel) and is walking distance to Alex Bay shops, bars and restaurants. This home offers dockage for up to a 38′ boat, Tiki Bar with grill, TV, sink, mini fridge and microwave as well as fire pit with Adirondack chairs. We provide all linens, a fully stocked kitchen and off street parking. This property includes the 4 bedroom home, a 1 bedroom apartment (separate building that is rented on an annual basis), storage barn, tiki bar, boat ramp and multiple docks that will be accessed by others.
